candidates.name: Spicy Lyrics API
candidates.reason: New publisher documentation reviewed 2026-10-19T06:46Z. The documented endpoint is GET /v1/lyrics/{trackId}; identity is a 22-character Spotify track ID. Response fields include source, timed content (Syllable/Line/Static), songwriter credits, translations/transliterations, and optional uploader/maker identity and URLs. Publisher requires bearer secret or publishable key; docs show a shared signed-out demo but its terms explicitly prohibit using it as a substitute for a key, so no API request or credential use was attempted and live access/extraction remain unverified. Terms require response-specific attribution wherever lyrics are shown; community sync contributors must be credited, and cached responses must be refetched or discarded within 30 days. Terms do not grant rights to lyric text, allow limited revocable use of community timing data subject to restrictions, prohibit redistribution/downloaders and substantial systematic extraction. Persistent user-saved/offline lyric storage may conflict with the 30-day retention rule and downloader restriction; do not integrate without publisher clarification and a compatible persistence model. Likely overlap with existing timed providers SyncLRC, Better Lyrics and Unison is unmeasured. No canaries, language coverage, or capability coverage established. Defer pending eligible app access, legal/product review of retention and user export semantics, attribution UI, and two independent live canaries; do not use the signed-out demo.

candidates.name: Hymnal API
candidates.reason: New multilingual candidate reviewed on 2026-10-20. Publisher page documents a public unauthenticated static JSON API, reporting 4,485 hymn records across seven collections and Malagasy, French and English. Metadata endpoints return collections or hymns without lyric bodies; a documented single-hymn endpoint returns a record with labeled verse text. A bounded live GET of https://hymnal.rindra.org/api/categories.json at 2026-10-20T06:01:43Z returned successfully with 7 records shaped as ID, Name and count; only collection names/counts were retained in sanitized evidence, no hymn/lyric IDs or text. Publisher documentation says free/open API but provides no explicit content license, per-work rights or attribution terms in the page reviewed; treat underlying hymn rights as unverified. Collections include two Malagasy sets (802 and 814 entries), French-language sets and English SDA Hymnal, a potentially useful regional/language supplement. Expected overlap with WorshipCommons, Wikisource and Open Hymnal is unmeasured. Documented routes expose metadata and static per-hymn lyrics, but no search endpoint; full single-hymn lyric extraction has not been tested, and grammar v1 cannot express the documented whole-catalog-plus-per-ID flow as normal search/resolve without adapter work. No chords or timing are documented. Keep deferred pending explicit rights/attribution and per-work provenance review, a compatible searchable adapter, and two independent live repository canaries covering identity and full lyric extraction.

Publisher reports148860 song additions during2024, not a current lyric/catalog total. Native production search/detail qualification2026-10-27T08:48:38Z passed exact publisher-linked IDs1501 Rollin' Girl/wowaka feat.Hatsune Miku and68814 ECHO/Crusher,CIRCRUSH feat.V3 GUMI(English): four200 responses, zero retries/network failures. Default name-sorted first5 rows missed both known versions; documented RatingScore sort brought each exact ID into bounded12-row native searches. Original lyric selected by unique Original variant, never array position; complete translated/romanized variants and source credits, names, artist-role records, album entries, culture codes, BPM range and raw JSON retained. Only explicit composer/lyricist roles and fixed BPM become those fields; multiple albums are not a guessed first album. Source entries remain arrangements with no confirmed recording IDs or timing. Publisher metadata is CC-BY4.0 with link-back; lyrics and uploaded images are expressly excluded, so lyric rights remain unknown. No artwork/audio/video fetched, account/cookies/credential use or restriction workaround. Nine synthetic regressions and real native controller/SQLite/ChordPro persistence replay passed; all source facts, every variant, full raw JSON, song JSON and hashes retained through reopen. The adapter is now registered in the candidate channel-4 runtime and implements the shared contextual-search interface. Its revision-15 catalog preserves all 23 channel-3 entries unchanged. Offline bootstrap, factory selection, default enablement, saved opt-outs, older cache streams and saved source/timing payload retention are qualified. Four real canonical probes returned HTTP 200 without retries or network failures, and the 24-source catalog passed offline structural validation. Device/cloud and compatible app-release qualification remain pending; the provider is not yet shipped. Missing or multiple original variants remain explicit unavailable/ambiguous outcomes. Incremental overlap, broader language coverage and independent musical/transcription accuracy unmeasured.

candidates.name: LyricsPlus / YouLy+ backend
candidates.reason: Anonymous documented catalog/V2 reads locally qualified through a bounded native adapter on 2026-10-27 at16:54Z: Billie Jean / Michael Jackson and Creep / Radiohead both passed search, V2 extraction, independent official Apple ID lookup and exact source-facts/word-timing ChordPro round trips. Six HTTP200, zero retries or network failures; no credentials, cookies, forceReload or mirrors. Earlier research made four ordinary reads; a first native attempt made three HTTP200 but exposed background-word interleaving, reproduced/fixed offline before one justified selected rerun. The dedicated parser/identity suite and combined provider/domain/controller tests pass; retained real bytes independently replay. Catalog rows group into provider-local title/artist lyric-document identities, preserving all original rows as hints; query echoes/Deezer ISRCs are never recording evidence. Returned unsupplied Apple IDs1883770432/1097862231 were independently verified. Billie actual album is Michael: Songs From The Motion Picture, distinct from the catalog hint Michael Jackson's This Is It; that contradiction is preserved rather than silently relabelled. Creep resolves to Pablo Honey. Preserve61/38 lines and488/190 word segments, background/singer/part metadata, original milliseconds/overlaps/raw bytes and unknown per-work rights/upstream attribution. Timing remains unverified and identity arrangement-scoped, with no recording IDs. Initially supports independently verified Apple winners only; other winners fail explicitly. Native code licensing is not lyric licensing. Deferred only for public native integration, compatible catalog/app release, normal app/SQLite verification and cloud reachability; no activation, corpus count or incremental overlap is claimed. The ordinary maintenance CLI separately passed both prospective probes with complete extraction capability coverage and six HTTP200; the ignored28-entry candidate catalog validates offline. Current channel6 intentionally omits this new native ID, so a compatible future channel is still required to close catalog_entry_missing before activation.
